# The API testing lab: real endpoints, real errors, guided challenges.

Practise CRUD, auth, rate limits, ETags and webhooks against 55 sandboxed mock REST APIs — no signup, results checked for you. Swagger-style docs, GraphQL, and every HTTP status code on demand. Pick an API and hit Try it out.

Send your first request → · Browse 23 challenges

## Fandom & Pop Culture

* Friends API — Characters, episodes & quotes from the coffee-house gang. (14 endpoints)
* Movies API — QA-themed cinema. Sort, filter, rate. (9 endpoints)
* Harry Potter API — Houses, students & spells from a magic school. (10 endpoints)
* Star Wars API — Characters, planets & starships from a galaxy far away. (11 endpoints)
* Sherlock Holmes API — Cases, suspects & clues from Baker Street. (10 endpoints)
* Pokémon API — Creatures, trainers & simulated battles. (10 endpoints)
* Middle-earth API — Fellowship, quests & artifacts from a fantasy realm. (9 endpoints)
* The Office API — Employees, pranks & quotes from a paper company. (8 endpoints)
* Marvel API — Avengers, villains & mission assignments. (10 endpoints)
* Game of Thrones API — Houses, nobles & dragons of Westeros. (12 endpoints)
* Rick and Morty API — Characters, locations & episodes across the multiverse. (9 endpoints)
* Starfleet API — Ships, warp limits & exponentially multiplying tribbles. (10 endpoints)
* GTA API — Characters, vehicles, weapons, missions, heists, a wanted system & radio stations across Los Santos, Vice City and Liberty City. (17 endpoints)
* Dragon Ball API — Fighters, transformations, power levels & tournaments. (6 endpoints)
* Voxel Worlds API — Block worlds, players, inventories & coordinates. (6 endpoints)
* Anime Tournament API — Original fighters, power levels & tournament brackets. (5 endpoints)
* Retro Quest API — Pixel heroes, quests, loot & save-game conflicts. (5 endpoints)

## Everyday Life

* Pizza Orders API — Place & track orders. Includes a guaranteed 500. (9 endpoints)
* Coffee Shop API — Drinks & orders. Home of the legendary 418. (6 endpoints)
* Football API — Soccer teams, squads, standings & simulated matches. (7 endpoints)
* Bank API — Accounts, transfers & cursor pagination. Home of the 402. (9 endpoints)
* Airline API — Flights, seat conflicts & overbooking drama. (9 endpoints)
* Shop API — Carts, stock drama & expired coupons. (12 endpoints)
* Cargo Tracking API — Shipment state machines. Writes need an X-API-Key. (9 endpoints)
* World Cup 2026 API — Teams, groups, venues, match simulation, tickets & bracket predictions across the 2026 host cities. (17 endpoints)
* FIBA World Cup API — Teams, Doha arenas, quarter-by-quarter game simulation, box scores, coach challenges, cursor-paged play-by-play & ticketing. (22 endpoints)
* Formula 1 API — Drivers, constructors, races, telemetry & pit stops. (7 endpoints)
* Pro Football League API — A fictional American football league: scores, live games, standings & leaders. (11 endpoints)
* Pro Basketball API — A fictional pro basketball league: box scores, live games & leaders. (11 endpoints)
* Baseball Stats API — A fictional baseball league: innings, standings, batting & pitching leaders. (11 endpoints)
* Weather API — Deterministic forecasts in °F or °C, alerts and outage scenarios. (5 endpoints)
* Food Delivery API — Orders, kitchen-to-door status, courier tracking & events. (8 endpoints)
* Stock Market Mock API — Fictional tickers: quotes, OHLCV history, market hours, 429s. (5 endpoints)

## Original Worlds

* Superhero API — Heroes, powers & nemeses. Great for nested resources. (6 endpoints)
* Dino Park API — Dinosaurs, enclosures & the occasional breach. (9 endpoints)
* Space Agency API — Launches, scrubs & probes with real signal lag. (9 endpoints)

## Testing Scenarios

* Auth Playground API — OAuth 2.0 flows — client credentials, auth code, refresh & expiry. (6 endpoints)
* Webhooks API — Register callbacks, trigger events, inspect & replay deliveries. (8 endpoints)
* Protocol Lab API — Async jobs, redirects, 503/504, JSON Patch & content negotiation. (12 endpoints)
* Payment Lifecycle API — Authorize, capture, refund and dispute synthetic payments. (7 endpoints)
* Reservation API — Capacity holds, expiry, confirmation, cancellation and explicit time zones. (5 endpoints)
* Object Storage API — Objects, checksums, ranges & resumable uploads. (8 endpoints)
* Modern Identity API — OIDC discovery, PKCE, device codes & token lifecycle. (8 endpoints)
* Event Streams API — SSE events, replay cursors, heartbeats & ordering. (4 endpoints)
* Fault Injection API — Latency, status codes, malformed payloads & flaky responses. (5 endpoints)
* Search & Facets API — Full-text queries, facets, highlights & cursor pagination. (2 endpoints)
* Fun Data Bridge API — Seeded fixtures from schemas, inspired by fundata.dev. (4 endpoints)
* Classic Fake REST API — Users, posts, comments, todos, products & carts — writes really persist. (43 endpoints)
* HTTP Echo & Inspect API — httpbin-style echo, headers, delays, redirects, auth and caching. (26 endpoints)
* Mock LLM API — OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible shapes: streaming, tools, 429s. (5 endpoints)
* MCP Test Server — A hosted Model Context Protocol server for testing MCP clients. (3 endpoints)
* FHIR R4 Health Records API — A synthetic FHIR R4 subset: Patient, Observation, Encounter. (11 endpoints)
* SOAP Web Service API — SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 with WSDLs, a calculator and real SOAP Faults. (4 endpoints)
* US Address Validation API — Validate and standardise US addresses, check ZIP against state. (3 endpoints)
* Random User API — Seeded random people in five locales — repeatable test data. (2 endpoints)

## FAQ

Do I need to sign up?

No. The web playground runs entirely in your browser with zero backend, and the live API accepts the documented tokens without registration.

Which Bearer token should I use?

`qa-admin-token` for full access, `qa-viewer-token` for read + write with 403 on DELETE. Anything else returns 401.

How do I reset sandbox data?

Click ↺ Reset sandbox data on any docs page, reload the page, or call `window.__funApiReset()` in the browser console. Against the live backend, requests are isolated by `X-Sandbox-ID`.

Can I export the API spec?

Yes — every docs page has download buttons for an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and a Postman collection, and the whole catalog is served as one OpenAPI 3.1 document at `/openapi.json`.

# Fun API Playground
> No-signup, browser-based mock REST API playground at https://funapi.dev.
> 55 mock APIs exposing 509 endpoints that behave like real
> servers — CRUD, pagination, filtering, Bearer/JWT/OAuth auth, optimistic
> concurrency, idempotency keys, rate limiting, webhooks with HMAC
> signatures, GraphQL, and the full zoo of HTTP status codes.
Key facts:
- No signup required; the web playground runs the entire API engine client-side in the browser with zero backend.
- A live backend (Firebase Cloud Functions) also serves the same endpoints over the real network for testing with curl, Postman or a test suite.
- Bearer tokens: `qa-admin-token` (full access), `qa-viewer-token` (read + write, DELETE returns 403), anything else returns 401.
- Every docs page ships Swagger-style interactive docs with a "Try it out" panel and ready-to-copy curl/fetch/Python/HTTPie snippets.
- OpenAPI 3.1 and Postman collection export are available from every docs page.
- Requests are isolated by `X-Sandbox-ID`; reset sandbox data from any docs page or via `POST /api/\_reset`.
- A GraphQL endpoint is served at `POST https://funapi.dev/graphql`, with a GraphiQL UI at the same URL. It is excluded from crawling in robots.txt (it is an interactive IDE, not a document), so it is listed here as an endpoint rather than a page.
Drop-in test targets (live base URLs; no signup):
- Classic Fake REST API — users, posts, comments, todos, products, carts, quotes in the familiar fake-API shape at https://funapi.dev/api/classic/v1 (e.g. GET /users?limit=5&skip=5&sort=age&order=desc&select=email). Writes persist per X-Sandbox-ID, records carry ETags (If-Match → 412), validation errors are 422 with per-field messages, lists send Link and X-Total-Count. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/classic
- HTTP Echo & Inspect API — httpbin-compatible paths at https://funapi.dev/api/echo/v1: /anything, /get, /post, /headers, /ip, /user-agent, /delay/{0-10}, /status/{code}, /redirect/{n}, /basic-auth/{user}/{password}, /bearer, /uuid, /base64/{value}, /json, /xml, /stream/{n}, /etag/{etag}, /cache/{seconds}, /response-headers. Cookie endpoints are not offered. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/echo
- Mock LLM API — OpenAI-compatible base URL https://funapi.dev/api/llm/v1 (POST /chat/completions, /embeddings, GET /models) and Anthropic-compatible base URL https://funapi.dev/api/llm (POST /v1/messages). Any non-empty API key works; responses are deterministic; streaming uses SSE. The model name selects the scenario: mock-echo, mock-json, mock-tool-call, mock-length, mock-content-filter, mock-slow (8 s), mock-stream-cut, mock-malformed-json, mock-429, mock-500, mock-503. No real model is called. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/llm
- MCP Test Server — Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP (JSON responses) at https://funapi.dev/api/mcp/v1/mcp; a Bearer-protected variant at https://funapi.dev/api/mcp/v1/secure/mcp (token: mcp-test-token). Tools: echo, add, get\_time, lookup\_user, fail, slow; resources, a resource template and a prompt. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/mcp
- Sports stats APIs (fictional leagues, no real teams or players) — Pro Football League API at https://funapi.dev/api/football-league/v1, Pro Basketball API at https://funapi.dev/api/basketball-league/v1, Baseball Stats API at https://funapi.dev/api/baseball/v1. Each has /teams, /teams/{id}/roster, /players (filters, paging), /games (scoreboard by week/team/status), /games/{id} with an ETag for If-None-Match polling, /games/{id}/plays?after=, POST /games/{id}/advance (Bearer qa-admin-token) to play the next period of the live game, /standings and /leaders?stat=. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/profootball, https://funapi.dev/docs/probasketball, https://funapi.dev/docs/baseball
- FHIR R4 Health Records API — a synthetic FHIR R4 subset at https://funapi.dev/api/fhir/r4: /metadata, Patient (search by name, family, gender, birthdate; read, create, update with If-Match, delete → 410), Observation (LOINC vitals; search by patient, code, category, date), Encounter. Responses are application/fhir+json, searches are searchset Bundles with next/previous links, errors are OperationOutcome. Reads are open; writes need Bearer qa-admin-token. Contains no real patient data. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/fhir
- Weather API — a no-key, deterministic weather API at https://funapi.dev/api/weather/v1: /locations, /current, /forecast (1–7 days), /hourly (1–48 h), /alerts?state=. units=us (°F, mph, in; default) or si (°C, km/h, mm). scenario=outage (503 + Retry-After), timeout (504 after 6 s) or stale (Warning header). Values are synthetic, never real observations. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/weather
- Food Delivery API — order lifecycle at https://funapi.dev/api/delivery/v1: restaurants and menus, POST /orders (server-computed totals, Idempotency-Key), status placed → accepted → preparing → picked\_up → delivered via POST /orders/{id}/advance (Bearer qa-admin-token), cancellation until pickup (then 409), courier tracking, and /events with duplicate=true and order=reverse. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/delivery
- Stock Market Mock API — fictional tickers (ZACM, ZBLU, ZQAT, ZNOV, ZPIX, ZGRD) at https://funapi.dev/api/stocks/v1: /symbols, /market-status (New York hours), /quote/{symbol}, /quotes?symbols=, /history/{symbol}?days= (daily OHLCV, 5 requests a minute then 429 + Retry-After). Deterministic, USD, not market data. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/stocks
- SOAP Web Service API — WSDLs at https://funapi.dev/api/soap/v1/calculator.wsdl and /countries.wsdl; POST SOAP 1.1 (text/xml) or 1.2 (application/soap+xml) envelopes to /calculator (Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide; divide by zero → Fault) and /countries (GetCountry by ISO code). SOAP 1.1 faults are HTTP 500; SOAP 1.2 sender faults are 400. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/soap
- US Address Validation API — POST https://funapi.dev/api/address/v1/validate standardises a US address (USPS-style abbreviations, ZIP+4) and flags ZIP/state mismatches; 422 per field for bad input; /zip/{zip} sample lookup; /states. Rule-based, not a USPS service. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/address
- Random User API — GET https://funapi.dev/api/people/v1/users?results=&seed=&nat=us,gb,de,tr,in&gender= returns generated people; the same seed always returns the same records. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/people
- GTA API (unofficial, fan-made Grand Theft Auto–themed sandbox; not affiliated with Rockstar Games) — https://funapi.dev/api/gta/v1: /characters (filter by city, affiliation), /vehicles (class) with POST /vehicles/{id}/respray, /weapons with POST /weapons/{id}/buy, /missions with prerequisites (POST /missions/{id}/start → 409 if one is active, 422 if prereq unmet), admin-only POST /heists, /wanted (0–5 stars; POST /wanted/increase takes ~2 s; DELETE /wanted costs $1000/star) and /radio. Cash starts at $5000 and 402 Payment Required fires when you are broke. Docs: https://funapi.dev/docs/gta
Full text: every page below, as plain text in one file, at https://funapi.dev/llms-full.txt
Blog full text: every published article, as plain text, at https://funapi.dev/llms-blog.txt
OpenAPI: the whole catalog as one OpenAPI 3.1 document at https://funapi.dev/openapi.json, and one
document per API at https://funapi.dev/docs/{api-id}/openapi.json. Both are generated from the same
catalog the docs pages render, so the spec and the documentation cannot describe different APIs.
Every page also declares these files with and in
its head.
## Pages
- [Home](https://funapi.dev/): the API catalog with search and category filters.
- [Getting started guide](https://funapi.dev/guide): auth, pagination, idempotency and optimistic concurrency in 5 minutes.
- [About](https://funapi.dev/about): what the playground is, how the browser engine and the live backend differ, what is real behaviour and what is invented data, and how caller data is isolated.
- [Challenges](https://funapi.dev/challenges): 23 hands-on API testing exercises in 7 groups, each one verified against the response your request actually produced.
- [Tools](https://funapi.dev/tools): fourteen utilities that run entirely in the browser and upload nothing — curl to code (nine languages), JWT decoder and encoder (HS256/384/512), HMAC webhook signature verifier, JSON formatter, JSON diff, JSON Schema generator (draft 2020-12), JSONPath tester, regex tester (with a catastrophic-backtracking guard), cron expression explainer, an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 linter (JSON or YAML), Base64 / base64url, UUID v4 / v7 generator and Unix timestamp converter.
- [Glossary](https://funapi.dev/glossary): 56 concepts the APIs exercise — from ETags, JWTs, OAuth 2.0, PKCE and HMAC signatures to Retry-After, JSON Patch, range requests and contract testing — each defined, with its common misconception and an endpoint that demonstrates it. Also in Turkish, German, Simplified Chinese, Hindi and Russian (see Languages below).
- [Comparisons](https://funapi.dev/compare): how this playground differs from JSONPlaceholder, httpbin, reqres, json-server, WireMock, Mockoon, Beeceptor, DummyJSON, Postman mock servers, PokeAPI, SWAPI, Restful Booker, Swagger Petstore, GoRest, FakeStoreAPI and Practice Software Testing — including what each of them does better; also balldontlie, the HAPI FHIR public test server, the National Weather Service API and local LLM mock servers (mockllm, llmock).
- [Blog](https://funapi.dev/blog): practical API testing guides and patterns.
- [Privacy notice](https://funapi.dev/privacy) and [Terms of use](https://funapi.dev/terms): what is stored and for how long, analytics consent, and acceptable use. Contact: info@funapi.dev.
- API docs (https://funapi.dev/docs/{api-id}): 55 pages, one per mock API, all listed at https://funapi.dev/docs. Every one is listed by URL under "API docs, in full" below — a map that gives you a pattern instead of addresses is not a map.
- [GraphQL guide](https://funapi.dev/docs/graphql): the public GraphQL endpoint at https://funapi.dev/graphql — its schema, example queries with variables and a mutation, and the cases worth testing: errors returned with HTTP 200, 400 for invalid or over-complex queries (depth 12, 100 fields), 405 for mutations over GET, 429 above 120 requests a minute.
- [HTTP status codes](https://funapi.dev/status): index of the 61 status codes the playground returns, including the non-standard nginx 499 and Cloudflare 520–526 — any of them on request from `GET https://funapi.dev/api/faults/v1/status/{code}`; each `https://funapi.dev/status/{code}` page explains the code, why you would provoke it, and lists the endpoints that return it.
- [Testing techniques](https://funapi.dev/testing): 10 hands-on guides at `https://funapi.dev/testing/{slug}` — pagination, rate-limiting, idempotency, optimistic-concurrency, webhook-signatures, auth-tokens, negative-testing, async-jobs, llm-streaming, mcp-clients.
- Categories (https://funapi.dev/category/{slug}): fandom, everyday-life, original-worlds, testing-scenarios.
## Languages
The site is published in English at the bare paths. Translated pages live
under a language prefix and carry a reciprocal hreflang cluster with the
English original as `x-default`:
- Turkish (`/tr`) and German (`/de`): the glossary, the getting started guide,
the testing techniques, the tools and the learning paths — e.g.
https://funapi.dev/tr/guide, https://funapi.dev/de/testing/pagination,
https://funapi.dev/tr/learn/postman, https://funapi.dev/tr/glossary/etag.
- Simplified Chinese (`/zh`), Hindi (`/hi`) and Russian (`/ru`): the glossary,
e.g. https://funapi.dev/zh/glossary.
Every other section, including API docs, is English. The interface itself can
be switched to any of these languages with `?lang=` (e.g.
https://funapi.dev/?lang=tr); `/tr`, `/de`, `/zh`, `/hi` and `/ru` redirect there.

- [GTA API](https://funapi.dev/docs/gta) — Characters, vehicles, weapons, missions, heists, a wanted system & radio stations across Los Santos, Vice City and Liberty City. 17 endpoints, base `/gta/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/gta/openapi.json
- [Dragon Ball API](https://funapi.dev/docs/dragonball) — Fighters, transformations, power levels & tournaments. 6 endpoints, base `/dragonball/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/dragonball/openapi.json
- [Formula 1 API](https://funapi.dev/docs/formula1) — Drivers, constructors, races, telemetry & pit stops. 7 endpoints, base `/formula1/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/formula1/openapi.json
- [Voxel Worlds API](https://funapi.dev/docs/voxel) — Block worlds, players, inventories & coordinates. 6 endpoints, base `/voxel/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/voxel/openapi.json
- [Anime Tournament API](https://funapi.dev/docs/anime) — Original fighters, power levels & tournament brackets. 5 endpoints, base `/anime/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/anime/openapi.json
- [Retro Quest API](https://funapi.dev/docs/retroquest) — Pixel heroes, quests, loot & save-game conflicts. 5 endpoints, base `/retro/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/retroquest/openapi.json
- [Object Storage API](https://funapi.dev/docs/storage) — Objects, checksums, ranges & resumable uploads. 8 endpoints, base `/storage/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/storage/openapi.json
- [Modern Identity API](https://funapi.dev/docs/identity) — OIDC discovery, PKCE, device codes & token lifecycle. 8 endpoints, base `/identity/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/identity/openapi.json
- [Event Streams API](https://funapi.dev/docs/streams) — SSE events, replay cursors, heartbeats & ordering. 4 endpoints, base `/streams/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/streams/openapi.json
- [Fault Injection API](https://funapi.dev/docs/faults) — Latency, status codes, malformed payloads & flaky responses. 5 endpoints, base `/faults/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/faults/openapi.json
- [Search & Facets API](https://funapi.dev/docs/searchlab) — Full-text queries, facets, highlights & cursor pagination. 2 endpoints, base `/search/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/searchlab/openapi.json
- [Fun Data Bridge API](https://funapi.dev/docs/datagen) — Seeded fixtures from schemas, inspired by fundata.dev. 4 endpoints, base `/data/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/datagen/openapi.json
- [Classic Fake REST API](https://funapi.dev/docs/classic) — Users, posts, comments, todos, products & carts — writes really persist. 43 endpoints, base `/classic/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/classic/openapi.json
- [HTTP Echo & Inspect API](https://funapi.dev/docs/echo) — httpbin-style echo, headers, delays, redirects, auth and caching. 26 endpoints, base `/echo/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/echo/openapi.json
- [Mock LLM API](https://funapi.dev/docs/llm) — OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible shapes: streaming, tools, 429s. 5 endpoints, base `/llm/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/llm/openapi.json
- [MCP Test Server](https://funapi.dev/docs/mcp) — A hosted Model Context Protocol server for testing MCP clients. 3 endpoints, base `/mcp/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/mcp/openapi.json
- [Pro Football League API](https://funapi.dev/docs/profootball) — A fictional American football league: scores, live games, standings & leaders. 11 endpoints, base `/football-league/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/profootball/openapi.json
- [Pro Basketball API](https://funapi.dev/docs/probasketball) — A fictional pro basketball league: box scores, live games & leaders. 11 endpoints, base `/basketball-league/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/probasketball/openapi.json
- [Baseball Stats API](https://funapi.dev/docs/baseball) — A fictional baseball league: innings, standings, batting & pitching leaders. 11 endpoints, base `/baseball/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/baseball/openapi.json
- [FHIR R4 Health Records API](https://funapi.dev/docs/fhir) — A synthetic FHIR R4 subset: Patient, Observation, Encounter. 11 endpoints, base `/fhir/r4`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/fhir/openapi.json
- [Weather API](https://funapi.dev/docs/weather) — Deterministic forecasts in °F or °C, alerts and outage scenarios. 5 endpoints, base `/weather/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/weather/openapi.json
- [Food Delivery API](https://funapi.dev/docs/delivery) — Orders, kitchen-to-door status, courier tracking & events. 8 endpoints, base `/delivery/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/delivery/openapi.json
- [Stock Market Mock API](https://funapi.dev/docs/stocks) — Fictional tickers: quotes, OHLCV history, market hours, 429s. 5 endpoints, base `/stocks/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/stocks/openapi.json
- [SOAP Web Service API](https://funapi.dev/docs/soap) — SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 with WSDLs, a calculator and real SOAP Faults. 4 endpoints, base `/soap/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/soap/openapi.json
- [US Address Validation API](https://funapi.dev/docs/address) — Validate and standardise US addresses, check ZIP against state. 3 endpoints, base `/address/v1`, spec at https://funapi.dev/docs/address/openapi.json
